args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

Sofia asked me to pass along these notes on the PHL label confusion. Bettina has reviewed them.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Filtering "PHL" returns both accounts, so please use the full account name, not PHL.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" (per Moss's coverage digest, 18 May). It needs the Pellow Home Living name.
- Some older exports and appointment headings still show Covey & Lark Retail. Check the export after any relabel.
- Open: relabel the saved report and confirm the export is clean. Could you confirm the CRM and name fields are done?

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (drafted with Bettina Kroll)
